metadata.title: Clicked like I was smashing my keyboard and Valorant said ‘Here’s a kill, enjoy’
metadata.description:
That moment when your brain checked out but you still got a kill.
Enemy probably uninstalling to question their life choices.
Valorant logic: handing out freebies for random button mashing.
If your aim’s a mystery, you’re in good company.

Tap if you’ve ever gotten a kill you didn’t deserve!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
